comments.author: Averroes
comments.body: Just want to explain how the discovery of the War god's amulet works, basically when you do a search near an npc, it will function as using observe, if you are near the amulet you will see a colum of light and if you have surveying on, it will mark the location on the mark. You then go to the mark and search a couple times and you will find the amulet. However you need to note that there is only one of these amulets on the map at any given time. After one player discovers it, no other player can discover it, because it is no longer there. You have to wait until the location refreshes to discover a new amulet, and when it refreshes, it will not be necessarly in the same location where you had discovered the previous one, because there are a number of locations on the North Calicut map where this item will be hidden, so you need to start the exploration once again. This is important because, if you are doing this quest in a fleet, then all the players that haven't discovered the amulet will need to wait until the refresh happens, and then only one other player can discover the amulet. The refresh may take several hours to occur, and so finishing this quest in a fleet will take a long time. So be aware, if I had to do this quest over again, I would had opted to do it solo or to buy the needed amulets in Seville prior to starting it. Good luck.
